test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: As per the announcement made by the Education Minister, Dharmendra Pradhan in August 2021, the duration of Samagra Shiksha Scheme 2 is from 1 April 2021 to __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**31 March 2026.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The duration of **Samagra Shiksha Scheme 2** is from** 1 April 2021** to **Tue Mar 31 2026** 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time).
 
• The Education Minister, **Dharmendra Pradhan,** made an announcement in **August 2021** regarding the duration of the Samagra Shiksha Scheme 2.
 
• The Samagra Shiksha Scheme is a flagship programme of the **Government of India** that aims to **provide quality education** to all children in the age group of** 3-18 years.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All **child-centric interventions** will be given directly to the students through **DBT mode **on an** IT-based platform **over time in order to increase the direct outreach of the program.
 
• The **NEP-recommended bilingual books** and teaching materials are included, along with a new component for the appointment of language teachers that covers **salaries, training expenses, and hiring costs.**
 
• It will now cover funding for** teaching and learning resources, native toys and games, and play-based activities **for government schools' pre-primary divisions.
 
• The program will provide support for **master instructors **for anganwadi workers and pre-primary teachers.
